epic.title: episode-guard-at-write
epic.intent_and_why: Reject an instruction-shaped episode statement at write time (apply_episode_delta.py), so a lane's own write-time check catches what the closeout suite (RealStoreTests) would otherwise catch later, after episodes already exist for the suite to scan.

definition_of_done: apply_episode_delta.py rejects a create/restate-assertion op whose statement trips verify_episode_observations.py's guard, scoped to the real store only.
RED-before/GREEN-after, control, and offender-naming evidence exist and pass against the real script.
No regression in the guard's own tests or the writer's existing fixtures.
Full clean-env cache-clean suite passes with 0 failed.

good_enough.mandatory_quality: Guard call sits in the apply phase, not inside validate_delta; validate_delta stays exactly as pure as before.
good_enough.appetite: One bounded gate, single-issue launch order.

hard_constraints: Do not modify scripts/verify_episode_observations.py or tests/test_episode_observations.py.
Do not change the guard's rules or its exception list.
Do not retro-fix existing episodes/ records.
fixed_decisions: Import verify_episode_observations.py's triggers_for()/EXCEPTIONS rather than reimplementing the guard's rules.
install_constellation.py must bundle verify_episode_observations.py and query_episodes.py as runtime companions of the writer.

current_wave.objective: Close the write-time gap for instruction-shaped episode statements before this lane's own closeout episodes are written.
exit_criteria: Clean-env cache-clean full suite: 0 failed, exceeding the main baseline's passed count.
